claims.finding: The results are already out: Galmed filed two 6-Ks on 2026-09-02 reporting interim results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 with a net loss of $2.7m, and the earliest admissible post-release reaction in the capture describes it as 'very disappointing... today after 1 year, ended up in confused out of focus and back to early stage bio company. No cash partnerships, dumping its own late stage assets & starting fresh and again expected delays' - so the 2026-09-03 calendar row is stale and what is left to trade is drift on a strategic reset, not a fresh surprise.

claims.why_not_priced: A nano-cap with 35,620 shares of average daily volume and no analyst coverage anywhere in the capture (n_queries=0 in every sweep) does not clear a strategy reversal in one session. The specific unpriced element is the character of the reset - abandoning late-stage assets for an early-stage restart destroys the 'cash-rich late-stage biotech with zero debt' thesis the shareholder base was holding, and that re-rating takes days in an illiquid name. If it were priced, the stock would not have needed a 1-for-8 reverse split three weeks ago to stay listed.
claims.independence: A separate pre-release corpus item from a different author on 2026-08-28 anticipated exactly this outcome from the other direction - 'nothing would be happening until 8 to 14 months... soon cracks will start emerging and low volume algorithms & shorts may start burning SP again. Our 52 wk low is $3.29. Can we go lower than this, yes?' - docs/8c2c7f33148bf6712100e164894cff256da07b40.txt

claims.finding: A POS AM (post-effective amendment) was filed on 2026-09-02, the same day as the results, on top of 424B3 prospectuses dated 2026-06-08 and 2026-06-22 and a POS EX on 2026-06-08 - and retail participants independently observed the company selling stock at the market on 2026-08-24 ('looks like they ATM'ing', 'I was thinking that the CEO was using Galmed as an ATM') - in a share that has just been reverse-split 1-for-8 on 2026-08-19 and sits 4.5% above its 52-week low.

claims.why_not_priced: Shelf housekeeping filings are invisible to every aggregator, and a POS AM landing on the same day as results is the mechanical prerequisite for continuing to sell stock immediately afterwards. In a name whose float has just been divided by eight, at-the-market supply against 35k shares a day of natural liquidity is the dominant price-setting force and nothing publishes it.
claims.independence: none of substance - shares the EDGAR index and the same Stocktwits body as finding 1, so one source cluster.
